name: Rue des Gestes — étape 14 · enfoncer, enterrer, s'étendre
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (man driving a fence post in with a mallet, squirrel burying an acorn in the flower bed, man cracking a walnut on the balcony, man launching a paper aeroplane from the upper window, man hauling a cart of bricks on the roof terrace), -ir/-re RIGHT (long tabby cat stretching out on the bench under a round mirror). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.

items.mirror: round mirror on the wall above the bench
